obfuscation_indicators: performance based on revisions to estimates
risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively specific and quantitatively anchored, detailing defense-budget reductions, sequestration exposure, delayed awards, and contract timing. Risk is meaningful but presented alongside strong program relevance, diversification, execution history, and growth expectations, producing a balanced-to-mildly confident tone. Dense accounting and contract-performance explanations increase complexity but do not appear materially evasive.
